subject: Annual prepay collection & tax contact runbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@starlift.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay collection & tax contact runbook

Hi Alex and Starlift team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood for your committed spend this year. To make invoicing and drawdowns operationally smooth on both sides, I put together a short runbook and proposed monthly draw schedule (attached). Major points: 

- Total committed spend: $1,200,000 over 12 months (monthly drawdowns of $100k).
- First invoice to be issued 2027-04-15, payment due net 30; first draw execution on 2027-05-01.
- We need a definitive VAT/tax point of contact per billing entity to ensure we apply the correct reverse-charge or VAT rate.
- Redwood will send consolidated monthly invoices, and we will issue consumption reports with each draw.

Please confirm: 1) invoice recipient email for AP, 2) VAT registration number & country for Starlift's billing entity, and 3) whether payment will come from the US entity or EU subsidiary (this affects VAT handling).

Attachment: Starlift_Annual_Prepay_Runbook_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you prefer, we can do a 20-min call tomorrow to lock these details.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Starlift_Annual_Prepay_Runbook_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alex Moreno <procurement@starlift.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: billingops@starlift.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay collection & tax contact runbook

Hi Naomi,

Appreciate the clear runbook — helpful. A few quick answers and asks: 

- AP email: billingops@starlift.ai (please CC for all invoices)
- VAT: Starlift Global LLC (US) — no VAT. Starlift EU BV (NL) — VAT: NL123456789. We will be paying from the US parent for Q2 draws, but plan to centralize EU billing after July.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a VAT-free US invoice or a separate EU invoice when we switch? Also need your W-9 and SOC2 report for procurement.

We can take the 20-min call Friday 10:00am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Procurement Manager, Starlift AI
[Attachment requested: Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <procurement@starlift.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay collection & tax contact runbook

Alex — thanks for the VAT details. A few internal notes and the bill ops plan: 

- For US-payments from Starlift Global LLC: we will send a standard US invoice (no VAT).
- When billing switches to Starlift EU BV, Redwood will issue EU invoices with VAT handling per the NL registration you provided. We will need a formal PO or email authorization before changing the billing entity.
- Drafted an invoice cadence: initial prepay invoice on 2027-04-15 (covering the first month), then monthly statements on the 1st of each month. We can include per-draw consumption detail in the statement file.
- Attached is our invoice template and the billing checklist for accounts receivable (Invoice_Template_Redwood.pdf).

Naomi/Marissa — I can own the AP onboarding and the DocuSign SOW if you want. We should also surface the revenue recognition team for any unusual tax treatment.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Invoice_Template_Redwood.pdf (pdf)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Annual prepay collection & tax contact runbook

Forwarding the thread — Alex confirmed AP email and VAT mapping. Key asks for ops: 

- Ben: please prepare the 2027-04-15 prepay invoice and include a line item that references PO ST-2027-1187. Confirm that AR will accept payment remittances to our US bank account (details to be included in the invoice).
- Marissa: can you confirm discounting/commitment credits schedule? Starlift is on a 12-month committed plan; they asked about monthly draw amounts versus quarterly invoicing. We proposed monthly draws but can do consolidated quarterly invoices if preferred. They indicated payments will originate in US for now.

I scheduled a 20-min call with their team Friday 10:00am PT. Please join if you can.

— Naomi
